results.evidence: onClick calls `duplicateInsight(insight as InsightModel, true)` then `setScenePanelOpen(false)`, closing the panel (also in overlay mode) during the duplication flow.
The `duplicateInsight(insight, true)` call is unchanged (true = redirect); `setScenePanelOpen(false)` is added after it, not replacing it.
`setScenePanelOpen(false)` is called unconditionally; the author admits it closes the sidebar on wide screens too, with no overlay check.
Both entry points call `urls.resourceTransfer('Insight', insight.id!, insight.short_id)`, and urls builds `?source_short_id=${encodeURIComponent(sourceShortId)}`.
paramsToProps passes searchParams.source_short_id as sourceShortId; sourceResourceUrl for 'Insight' returns `urls.insightView(sourceShortId as InsightShortId)`.
Dashboard and Survey cases still use urls.dashboard(resourceId)/urls.survey(resourceId); the extra param is only added when sourceShortId is provided, which only insight callers pass.

result:
I made all three fixes but haven't run typecheck or tests. There is also one open point on the Back link, below.

- **Duplicate on a narrow screen:** the actions sidebar now closes right after you click Duplicate, so the new copy is visible. The change is in `InsightPanelActions.tsx` and calls `setScenePanelOpen(false)`. It closes the sidebar on wide screens too, since the panel state has no width check. The menu-bar Duplicate item is untouched because it isn't the sidebar.
- **Transfer page Back link:** the old link was built from the numeric insight ID, and insight URLs only work with the short ID.
  - The transfer URL now carries an optional `?source_short_id=` (`urls.resourceTransfer` in `urls.ts`).
  - Both insight "copy to project" entry points pass `insight.short_id`.
  - `ResourceTransfer.tsx` builds Back with `urls.insightView(shortId)`, the same builder used to open insights elsewhere.
  - If the parameter is missing, for example on an old bookmarked transfer URL, Back goes to the saved insights list instead.
- **Subscriptions empty state:** the featured card in `SubscriptionOverviewComponents.tsx` now uses a container query. When the card's own width is below the `@sm` breakpoint, the illustration is hidden and the text takes the full width.

The Back link needed the extra URL parameter because I found no existing route that opens an insight by its numeric ID. If you know of one, using it would avoid the new parameter.

I didn't add any tests.
